description: This Python source file defines an ImageProcessor class that processes and analyzes medical images using OpenAI's GPT-4V model. It reads image files, encodes them in base64, constructs prompts, and makes asynchronous API calls to generate medical image analyses.

classes.name: ImageProcessor
classes.description: A class for processing and analyzing medical images with GPT-4V, including image encoding and API interaction.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the ImageProcessor with an OpenAI API client using the API key from settings.

methods.name: analyze_image
methods.description: Asynchronously analyzes a medical image at the given path, optionally with contextual text, by sending a prompt to GPT-4V and returning the analysis.
